rationale: Identifiers are linkage keys, not features.
May define cancer instance but final mapping requires medical review.
Strict main analysis requires advanced_evidence_day < t0.
Index NGS report must be strictly before t0.
The selected treatment is the label/candidate observation, not an input feature.
Use only prior history and line context; no future regimen fields.
Outcome/follow-up fields are labels or censoring information.
Death and last-alive/follow-up fields leak future information.
